summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (stdlib only, os and json), exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four specified cases. Per instructions, I did not run tests, linters, or repository code, and did not commit. Black/flake8 compliance was only checked by line-length inspection (no line over 120 columns), so it is unverified. Choices made: missing image/label fields are skipped rather than rejected; a non-list data_list_key value raises ValueError; invalid JSON is re-raised as ValueError naming the file.
